description: Measure the distance and angle between two points, items or an item and a point, as the Measure tool shows them in the Info panel; for two items also the gaps between their edges

from.description: Where to measure from: an item (id, and which point of it) or a point on a page (pageIndex, x, y)

point.description: Which point of the item (default center)

x.description: Free point: mm from the left of the page

y.description: Free point: mm from the top of the page

to.description: Where to measure to: an item (id, and which point of it) or a point on a page (pageIndex, x, y)

point.description: Which point of the item (default center)

x.description: Free point: mm from the left of the page

y.description: Free point: mm from the top of the page

name: measure_between
title: Measure Between
